sections.Profile:
"Poker" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Playmatic in 1969. The game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, and four captive balls.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1969
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Poker, Wedgehead, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme
